trainer.dialogueBefore: Team Rocket Grunt: Silph Co. belongs to Team Rocket now! Get out!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Team Rocket Grunt: Ugh! The boss will hear about this.

worker_m.name: Worker
dialog: I hid in the corner when they came in. I'm still hiding, really.

worker_f.name: Worker
dialog: Team Rocket burst in and took over the whole building. We can't go home!

worker_m_2.name: Worker
dialog: They're after the Master Ball, a ball that never fails. The president won't hand it over.

worker_m_3.name: Worker
dialog: Please, save the president! He's on the top floor.

worker_f_2.name: Worker
dialog: The doors are locked by card. The Card Key is somewhere in the building.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Scientist Taylor: Team Rocket pays better than Silph Co. ever did!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Scientist Taylor: Maybe I should go back to my old job.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Team Rocket Grunt: You again? How did you get in here?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Team Rocket Grunt: Fine, fine. You win this one.
